entities.summary: St. Bonaventure University is a private Franciscan university in St. Bonaventure, New York, United States. The Western New York campus is home to 2,134 undergraduate and graduate students, with an additional 919 graduate students enrolled in online programs. The Franciscans established the university in 1858. Bonaventure University is a university in Americas, established in 1858. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
